name: litbible-notebook-service
description: Cloudflare Worker and D1 database that hold each signed-in reader's Study Desk notebook, sealed so the service can't read it (STUDY-DESK-ENCRYPTION.md, "The service's interface").

scripts.check: wrangler deploy --env preview --dry-run --outdir=.wrangler-check && wrangler deploy --env production --dry-run --outdir=.wrangler-check
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env preview --local
scripts.migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env preview --remote
scripts.migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
